<thought>Based on the provided fragments—benzene (c1ccccc1), two CO groups, and a chlorine—the simplest combined SMILES that incorporates all fragments is “c1ccccc1COCOCl”. This string connects the fragments linearly to the aromatic ring and includes the chlorine atom.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1COCOCl</final_answer>
